dialogue.Introduction: Greetings, @. I am the Witch Doctor, and this treehouse is my home now.#$b#The jungle spirits whispered that a farmer would come to the island. They were right, as spirits usually are.$u
dialogue.Mon: Good morning, @. The jungle spirits are quiet today, which means they are thinking. Let them think.$h
dialogue.Tue: The Merchant sells bottled bug juice in town, I hear. I told him it tastes of sorrow. He laughed, so he does not know sorrow yet.$h
dialogue.Wed: The moon was full last night. The spirits sang all through it and I did not sleep a wink. Do not ask how I feel.$s
dialogue.Thu: A little bird landed on my treehouse this morning and told me the Nurse is out of healing potions again. Something must be done.$u
dialogue.Fri: I have been drying herbs for my tonic. Sit, watch, and breathe in the smell. The smell is half the medicine.$h
dialogue.Sat: The Steampunker sent me a gear for my drum. It is a strange gift, but the drum is grateful.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday is for wandering the jungle to find roots. Care to come along?$h
dialogue.Mon2: Welcome to the treehouse. Please do not touch the drum. It is older than your farm and it does not like strangers.$u
dialogue.Tue2: Shall I tell you what the roots say today? They say the rain will come soon. Carry a coat.$h
dialogue.Wed2: The Guide says I should share my mushrooms with the valley. I say the mushrooms should decide that for themselves.$h
dialogue.Fri2: You walk the island paths very quietly for a farmer. Good. The jungle likes quiet folk.$h
dialogue.Sun2: The sun is high and I always feel hot this time of year. Could you bring me some cool water, or is that asking too much?$s
dialogue.Sat2: The Pirate was here yesterday with his parrot. The parrot is cleverer than the Pirate, and I told him so.$h
dialogue.Mon4: @, you are becoming a friend to the island spirits. They laughed when you passed the big fern, and the fern never laughs.$h
dialogue.Tue4: Sometimes I think the roots of the valley speak to each other, and the farmer hears them most. I have seen you talking to the crops.$h
dialogue.Wed4: The Dryad would call this a good sign. She has lived in the forest longer than the village has had a name. I think she likes you.$h
dialogue.Thu4: My grandmother taught me to read the roots. She said a good healer listens first and speaks second. You listen well, @.$h
dialogue.Fri4: I am glad you visit when the herbs are ripe. Visitors who come at the right time bring the right luck.$h
dialogue.Sat4: The Angler keeps telling me about giant fish. He is only a child, so I nod and say the spirits told me too. He believes it.$h
dialogue.Sun4: Rest with me a while, @. The sea wind is soft today and the treehouse sways a little. It reminds me of home.$h
dialogue.Mon6: Sometimes I dream of the valley from above, the farm roofs like little toys. In the dream you are always walking toward the mountain.$h
dialogue.Tue6: The Clothier came by asking about my spare drum. I explained that drums are for spirits, and he looked disappointed. He has a sad past, I think.$s
dialogue.Thu6: The Stylist keeps sending me fancy hats. I wear them while I drum, and the spirits laugh at my hat every time. Good for the spirits, I suppose.$h
dialogue.Fri6: Here is a secret for the wise. Leave a few herbs at the base of the old tree and it grows stronger. I learned that from the tree on the beach.$h
dialogue.Sat6: Sometimes I walk to the beach to watch the Pirate arrive. He tells tall tales about sea monsters. I ask him to stop, and then I listen anyway.$h
dialogue.Mon8: Sometimes the spirits show me the valley through their eyes. In their vision I saw you planting seeds in the rain. You did not stop, even when the sky cried.$l
dialogue.Tue8: Before the island, I lived far from people. I was afraid they would fear my drums. You did not fear them, and that is why I trust you.$s
dialogue.Wed8: There is a secret in the roots of Ginger Island. I was going to keep it for myself, but I think you should know it first. Come closer.$l
dialogue.Thu8: I dreamed of you, @, and in the dream you carried a lantern through the jungle. You were not lost. You were guiding others.$h
dialogue.Fri8: I wonder if I will one day leave this island and see the mines and the saloon. The spirits say yes. I hope they are right.$s
dialogue.Sat8: When you come up the ladder, the ferns bend toward you. I used to think that was only the wind. Now I am not sure.$l
dialogue.Sun8: If the valley ever needs a healer, I hope you will call on me. I will come with my drum and my herbs, and I will keep you safe.$h
dialogue.Mon10: @, you have walked the jungle with me and held my hand over the old roots. I have no words for how much that meant. Only the drum knows, and it is playing softly now.$l
dialogue.Wed10: I have decided you are my friend, and friends should know the sound of my drum by heart. Listen now. Boom, boom, quiet. That is me saying hello when I cannot say it.$l
dialogue.summer_Wed: Summer Wednesdays are my favorite. The heat makes the herbs bloom and the spirits drowsy.$h
dialogue.fall_Fri: The autumn leaves fall on my drum and the spirits cannot decide if they like it. Neither can I.$u
dialogue.winter_Sun: Winter on the island is strange, @. Snow does not fall here, but the spirits still shiver.$s
dialogue.spring_Mon: Spring is when the seeds wake up. I put my ear to the earth and it sounds like a thousand tiny drums.$h
dialogue.spring_12: Spring twelfth. The spirits asked me to sing for the sprouts today. I sang badly, and the sprouts grew anyway.$h
dialogue.winter_9: Winter ninth. A cold wind came down from the mountain, and I wore three coats and two hats. The spirits called me a pile of fur.$h

rainy: The rain drums on the treehouse roof and the spirits drum along with it. Come in, @, and listen to the storm. It is the best music on the island.$h

situations.eye: The great eye is gone from the sky, @. The spirits danced all night and I danced with them. I hope you rested too.$h
situations.evilBoss: The worm and the brain have both fallen. The island spirits went quiet with relief. Your deeds are sung about in the jungle now.$h
situations.skeletron: Skeletron is defeated, and the old man is free in the dungeon. A sad old soul is at peace again. Visit him when you can.$h
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is gone. Her hive is empty and the jungle buzzes less. Honey is in short supply, but my heart is light.$h
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh has fallen and the Hallow is spreading. The spirits sing louder now, but some of the songs are sharp and dangerous. Be careful, @.$s
situations.mechs: One of the mechanical bosses is destroyed. The Steampunker is rushing about in her goggles. I think she is very happy, and I think she wants to be left alone.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera is defeated and the jungle temple is open. The temple walls remember the old songs, and I hope you will listen to them before you go in.$u
situations.golem: The Golem has fallen and the temple spirits are finally resting. I felt the stone stop humming. It is a strange quiet, but a kind one.$h
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist is gone and the celestial pillars shine in the sky. The spirits sang their names so loudly that I heard them from my treehouse.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord has been defeated. Even the old spirits look up at the sky with new eyes. The sky has been quiet since, and I am grateful.$h
situations.goblins: The goblin army was driven off last night. The Goblin Tinkerer swears he was never one of them, and I believe him. Good work, @.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates were sent packing from the beach. The Pirate himself stood on the sand and cheered, while his parrot screamed the whole time.$h
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is repelled. The cold wind has calmed in the valley. The spirits say you fought with courage, and I agree.$h
situations.martians: The Martian Madness is over and the strange lights have left the sky. The spirits did not like them at all. I hope no more come.$s
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night, and the spirits howled all through it. I stayed inside, drumming softly to calm them. Please be careful after dark.$s
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark for a while yesterday. The spirits were frightened and the birds stopped singing. It is over now, but I still feel the chill.$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today, and the drums are already sounding in the distance. Dance with the spirits if you can, @. I will be there.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival is here, and I hid an egg somewhere in the jungle for someone to find. I hope it is you, @.$h
festivals.spring24: At the Flower Dance the spirits love the flower garlands. I will not dance, but I will watch you and drum softly.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau! I brought a jungle root for the community soup. It is bitter, but bitter things make the best medicine.$h
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies is tonight. The jellies glow in the water and the spirits come to see them. Do not miss it, @.$h
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair. I entered my drum in the contest and the judges look nervous. Wish me luck.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! The spirits of the island walk tonight, and they are very happy about it. Do not get lost in the maze, @.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice. I am no good at ice fishing, but the spirits pull fish out of the cold water with their own hands. Watch out for me.$h
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star. I wrapped a gift for you. The paper is made of jungle leaves and it is a little bit crooked.$h

loved.text: Ah, the spirit-touched things. You have a good eye, @. I can feel the jungle in this one.$h

liked.text: This is pleasing. The island likes it too.$h

neutral.text: Thank you, @. I will take it up the ladder and think on it.

disliked.text: Hmm. This does not sit well with the spirits. I will keep it, I suppose, but I will not wear it.$s

hated.text: No! Take this away from me. Metal sings sour songs and the spirits hate them. Please remove it from my sight.$a

events.after: Do not touch the drum when I am not looking, alright?

steps.say: Ah, @. Come up the ladder quickly, before the spirits notice the door is open.$h

answers.reply: Real enough to keep me company, @.$h

answers.text: I think it is just the wind.
answers.reply: The wind is only a spirit that has not found its voice yet.$a

steps.say: Sit by the drum. I will play one soft beat so you can feel the island under your feet.$h

events.after: The forest was kind to you today. Remember that.

steps.say: Walk with me into the trees. These roots are older than your farm, and they remember every footstep.$h
Look at this root. It glows faintly. A spirit root only glows for people the forest trusts.$u

steps.question: Do you ever hear the trees talk?

answers.text: Only when the wind is loud.
answers.reply: Ha. The wind does the talking, but the trees do the listening.$h
Then you have not been listening hard enough. They speak softly to those who wait.$s

steps.say: Keep your ears open, @. The forest will tell you its secrets if you let it.$h
Tonight the drums are slow and the spirits are gentle. Sit close, @, and listen.$h
The old ones of the forest have sent a guest. I have promised her the warmest spot by the fire.$h
Dryad, this is @. The spirits hummed their name all afternoon, so I think you will get along.$h

steps.question: Shall we share a drum beat?

answers.reply: Then sit, and let the rhythm find you. Boom, boom, quiet.$h
Rest, then. The spirits will wait for you.$s

events.after: The sea spirits still hum your name. I can hear them from here.

steps.say: The waves are loud tonight. I came to the beach to think, and you found me. Do not look so surprised.$u
The sea spirits sing to me when the moon is high. Tonight they sang your name, @. I am not sure what it means yet.$l

steps.question: What do the sea spirits sing?

answers.text: Tales of the deep and of brave friends.
answers.reply: Brave friends. Yes. That is what they always sing about.$h
You are cruel to the ocean, but I forgive you.$a

steps.say: Sit beside me on the sand. Let us listen together, @, until the moon goes down.$h

events.after: The charm is warm in my hand, @. It is warm because you hold it too.

steps.say: Come in, @. You have walked the island with me for many days, and now the spirits want to see us properly together.$l
I want to give you something. It is no treasure, only a small charm carved from jungle wood. Keep it close to your heart.$l
Thank you for always coming back up the ladder. I think I was waiting for someone like you for a very long time.$s
Now play one beat with me. Boom, boom, quiet. That is what I mean when I cannot say it.$h
